messages:
Maria: Quick heads up — tiny agenda shuffle for today's all-hands. Roadmap slot moving up 10m so leadership Q&A is after product updates. Also, test record failed 1/2. Can AV team triage?
Devon: On it. I'm at the meeting room trying to repro the record issue. Mic routing seems flaky when laptop goes to sleep.
Sam: I have OBS open as backup. Do we have the RTMP key for the alternate stream?
Maria: DMing the backup RTMP key to @Sam and @Devon now. Use `rtmp://stream.redwood-infer.example/live` + key in the DM.
Irene: Heads-up for Qs — prioritize cross-team product impacts and Dedicated/Private roadmap clarifications. Please drop short bullets in this thread we can surface. :white_check_mark:
Jordan: Thanks — I'll reserve the last 10 for live leadership Q&A. If there are controversial roadmap asks, we'll follow up asynchronously.
Devon: Repro notes: laptop sleep + USB hub = audio drop. Temporary fix: disable power saving and force ethernet.
Sam: Captioning isn't showing in preview. Local caption bridge crashed with stack: ```Error: caption-service timeout (503) at /svc/caption```
Maria: Ops, caption service is flaky this morning — @OpsBot can you spin the SRT caption bridge?
OpsBot: caption-service: attempting restart on host infra-caption-02... restart initiated. Fallback SRT endpoint: srt://fallback.redwood-infer:9999
Devon: Audio crackle reduced after switching presenter to room mic and ethernet. Laptop still intermittent. Recommend we stick to room PC for slides.
Irene: Slide ask: can we share the roadmap PDF in #all-hands-assets before we go live? Some partners want to reference it during the Q&A.
Maria: Uploading v1 now to #all-hands-assets and pinning. Note: deck still has placeholder numbers on the Dedicated pricing slide, we'll call out they are drafts.
Sam: OBS backup ready — if recording doesn't start, I'll push stream to the private RTMP and record locally. Command I'm using: `ffmpeg -i rtmp://local -c copy backup_ah.mp4`
Jordan: One ask for leadership Q: timeline for the Private on-prem preview? Short answer fine — rough quarters okay.
Irene: I'll collect roadmap Qs below — please add one-sentence context and which team needs the follow-up. :point_down:
Sam: Q: Will there be a migration tool for Dedicated -> Private customers, or is it manual? (Platform team)
Devon: Q: Any change to autoscaling policy defaults for Dedicated in next quarter? (Infra)
Maria: Q: Can product publish a short compatibility matrix for quantization profiles vs. hardware? (Eng-ML)
Jordan: Good set — we'll aim to answer live, otherwise commit to written follow-up within 3 business days.
OpsBot: recording: primary recorder failed to initialize (err: /dev/snd busy). Failover to backup recorder `recfarm-02` in progress.
Devon: Confirmed backup recorder up and streaming to S3. I'm monitoring latency.
Sam: When you push the stream to the backup RTMP, ping here so I can start local recording too.
Maria: Pushed. Backup stream live now. Everyone — quick mic check? Jordan, can you say "redwood all hands check"?
Jordan: "redwood all hands check"
Irene: Heard Jordan cleanly. :thumbsup:
Sam: Local record started. Captions on fallback SRT are flowing.
Maria: Great — proceeding. If folks want specific follow-ups from leadership, add them before the end of the session or flag with :raised_hand:. I'll compile notes and open a follow-up doc.
Devon: Leaving monitoring in place. Ping me if audio dips again.
Sam: Logging: backup-recording-size ~0.9GB in first 8m, looks healthy.
Maria: Thanks all. See you live in ~3m.
